Paragraph with bold, italic, and a link

```typescript title="WebAssembly"

function main() {
  const result = convert("<p>This has <strong>bold</strong>, <em>italic</em>, and a <a href=\"https://example.com\">link</a>.</p>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
